description: This file defines a test implementation of the IGrainDirectoryCache interface, providing methods to add, update, remove, and look up grain addresses in a cache, along with tracking operations performed.

classes.name: TestDirectoryCache
classes.description: A test implementation of IGrainDirectoryCache that wraps an inner cache and records operations performed.

classes.name: CacheOperation
classes.description: A record hierarchy representing different cache operations such as add, update, remove, and lookup.

methods.name: TestDirectoryCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the inner cache using a factory method.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds or updates a grain address in the cache and records the operation.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the cache and records the operation.

methods.name: LookUp
methods.description: Looks up a grain ID in the cache, outputs the result, and records the lookup operation.

methods.name: Remove (by GrainId)
methods.description: Removes a grain ID from the cache and records the removal.

methods.name: Remove (by GrainAddress)
methods.description: Removes a grain address from the cache and records the removal.
